newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila C. Bank lifts term reverse repo rates.
newsitem.headline: Manila C. Bank lifts term reverse repo rates.

text.p: The Philippine Central Bank on Thursday lifted its term reverse repo (rrp) rates after raising its overnight rates.
Its five-day reverse repo rate is now at 25 percent from 10.5 percent.

Its other term rrp rates were adjusted upwards by 1.125 percentage points each. The one-month reverse repo is now at 12.375 percent from 11.25 percent; two months, up at 12.50 percent from 11.375 percent; and the three and six months, up at 12.625 percent each from 11.5 percent.
It also set the rate for its 90-day special series Treasury bills at 12.1 percent.
